target_customer: B2B revenue and marketing teams that pay to capture, qualify and convert inbound leads with agents
problem: Inbound lead forms lose conversions and teams lack staff for marketing operations. Surface Labs started with intelligent forms and now sells agent teams for marketing and other operations.
business_model: Enterprise B2B software sold through demos, with agent based workflows
product_category: AI agents for marketing and revenue operations

founders.name: Saharsh Agrawal
education: UC Berkeley, B.S. and M.S. in EECS
founders.background_notes: YC page; met co-founder as a freshman at UC Berkeley and his Master's focused on security research.

founders.name: Arjun Sahai
founders.background_notes: YC page says he joined Snowflake's first growth team and raised sign up conversion by 70 percent.

technical_complexity.rationale: Agent workflows over CRM, forms, enrichment and campaign systems built on commercial language models; integration heavy rather than research heavy.

defensibility.rationale: Embedded in lead flow and CRM, but marketing automation vendors and many AI agent startups offer similar workflows.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found of a specific copy or acquisition; the marketing automation incumbents are adding AI agents generally.

market_need_then: Founders cite conversion work at Snowflake as the origin and later customers report conversion lifts, all self reported. No dated 2023 market source found.

branding.domain_note: Uses withsurface.com, a prefix variant, rather than surface.com.

identity.logo: Black on white wordmark per the site
identity.visual_style: Minimal, black and white with grayscale customer logos
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, outcome driven with specific metrics

brand_strength.rationale: Name collides with Microsoft Surface and Resurface Labs in search, and no brand press was found.

pivots.from: Earlier ideas after joining YC (not specified)
pivots.to: Intelligent forms for lead conversion, later AI agents for marketing operations
pivots.why: A search snippet from the YC profile says founders pivoted a couple of times and settled on work they had first hand experience with

pivots.to: Agent teams for broader enterprise operations (supply chain, KYC, AML, FP&A)
pivots.why: Current YC description; reason not found

outcome_analysis: Surface Labs pivoted after YC S23 into intelligent forms and then agent teams, and now names customers such as Nextiva, Juicebox and Valley with a ten person team. Funding is not confirmed by a primary source, no exit or shutdown was found, and customer lift figures are company claims, so traction is unverified.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators report $500K pre-seed in September or October 2023 with Y Combinator and Pioneer Fund (extruct, vcbacked, CB Insights); everydev reports $130K seed and over $630K total; seedtable shows none. Job posts say backed by Garry Tan and Dharmesh Shah, no amounts. One profile lists a different CEO, conflicting with YC and the podcast; ignored. No dated competitor sources near 2023 were found, so the list is empty. Resurface Labs is a different company. Completeness pass: the 500K pre-seed is recorded from VCBacked (date 2023-09; EveryDev dates it 2023-10-06 and also lists a separate 130K seed with total over 630K, not recorded). Pioneer Fund as investor appears on CB Insights and Extruct only. Rests on aggregators; no press release found.
